baseline_models.focus_anchor: The min-phrase at words 4-5 makes the unbelieving group the relation against which the present-tense laughter at word 6 is directed.
baseline_models.mechanism: A decisive event-now places trusting assent in the subject position, truth-covering in the opposed position, and the former mockery-object relation in reverse.

activation_trace.role: A severe event-day supplies the decisive now at which social positions can be reversed.
Trusting confirmation identifies the subject group by its settled assent and makes vindication intelligible.
Rejection or concealment of truth identifies the opposed group and supplies the reason it can become an object of exposure.
The branch in which someone is made an object of laughter gives the min-phrase a directed counter-mockery function.

changed_reading.before: Believers happen to feel amusement on that day.
changed_reading.after: At the decisive present, those vindicated in trust laugh specifically at the truth-rejecting group; the social relation itself has turned.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The believing subject at word 3 and the bodily laughter at word 6 can be read as an inward-to-outward sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled security releases the face from fear; inward assurance becomes visible as an opened face and joy rather than remaining a merely doctrinal label.

activation_trace.role: Settled safety and trust supply the inward state from which bodily release can proceed.
The face opening and teeth becoming visible turn inward safety into an observable bodily event.
Joy or wonder expressed through laughter keeps relief and astonishment live beside derision.

changed_reading.before: The laughter is only a triumphant jeer at another group.
changed_reading.after: The laughter can also be the visible release of a group whose fear has ended, with joy and wonder coexisting with directed reversal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacent roots at words 5 and 6 oppose covering with a form of conspicuous opening or gleam.
baseline_models.mechanism: The event-day converts concealment into visibility: what rejected or covered truth is confronted by an unmistakable outward sign on the faces of those who trusted it.

activation_trace.role: The notable occurrence supplies the temporal threshold at which hidden relations become manifest.
Concrete covering supplies the concealment pole of the focus ayah's contrast.
A visible gleam supplies the disclosure pole, making laughter function as evidence that can be seen.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports one party's emotion toward another.
changed_reading.after: The ayah also stages an epistemic event: covering meets a visible gleam, so laughter becomes public disclosure of what had been denied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening asymmetry takes fullness for oneself while imposing loss on others. Against that mechanism, the focus reversal reads like a publicly completed and rebalanced account rather than free-standing cruelty.

activation_trace.role: Directed laughter supplies the reversed social result whose proportionality the measuring sequence tests.
Measuring one matter against another supplies the comparison structure behind the unequal exchange.
Completion without shortfall supplies the norm claimed for self and denied to others.
A scale of justice supplies the balancing function by which the later reversal can rectify the earlier asymmetry.
Shorting measure names the operative harm that the reversed relation answers.

structural_cues: The branchless 83:1 label opens the taking-full/giving-short sequence in 83:2-3, while 83:34 reverses who occupies the advantaged position.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies asymmetric measurement, loss, and directed laughter; I infer that the later social reversal functions as settlement of that imbalance, while simple derision unrelated to commerce remains live.

changed_reading.before: The believers merely return the mockery in kind.
changed_reading.after: Their laughter marks a completed rebalancing of a world built on taking fullness and exporting loss; retaliation remains present but is constrained by rectification.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rousing the still, the immense event-day, and universal standing load the focus's opening 'today' with activation: it is the occasion that raises bodies and simultaneously changes who stands socially above whom.

activation_trace.role: The event-day branch anchors the focus adverb as a decisive occurrence rather than an ordinary date.
Rousing something motionless supplies the transition from a fixed old order to an activated one.
The earlier event-day explicitly primes the same temporal root as a momentous occurrence.
A great descending event gives the occasion disruptive scale and force.
Resurrection and the standing of the Hour make bodily rising the scene in which social reversal occurs.

structural_cues: 83:4-6 moves in sequence from being raised, to the immense day, to all people standing; 83:34 reopens with that day now made present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rousing, an immense event, standing, and the repeated day-root; I infer that this activation also overturns social posture, while the live alternative limits the sequence to temporal identification.

changed_reading.before: Today is a neutral timestamp for the laughter.
changed_reading.after: Today is the activating event itself: the old arrangement is made to rise and turn, and the laughter registers that changed posture.

context_deltas.mechanism: Binding judgment into an inscribed record, blocking access, and then admitting witnesses transforms the focus's cover-to-gleam opposition into public evidentiary disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the obscured side of an evidentiary contrast.
A conspicuous gleam makes the believers' laughter an outward sign rather than inaccessible feeling.
A binding inscription that entails judgment supplies an outcome fixed independently of either group's performance.
A visibly patterned mark supplies inspectability to the otherwise abstract record.
Prevented access supplies the exclusion that the focus's visible opening contrasts with.
Presence with observation supplies a public witnessing frame for the manifested result.

structural_cues: The opposed records in 83:7-9 and 83:18-21 repeat the same inscribed-book construction around the access barrier of 83:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding records, visible marks, blocked access, and witnesses; I infer that laughter displays rather than causes the verdict, while private relief remains an alternative function.

changed_reading.before: Laughter expresses the victors' private reaction.
changed_reading.after: Laughter is a public, witnessable disclosure of an already inscribed judgment: the formerly covered truth has acquired a face.

context_deltas.mechanism: Good condition, facial radiance, a selected pure drink, and competition for what is precious create a fullness that cannot remain inward; the focus laughter is the bodily overflow of plenitude as well as a response to opponents.

activation_trace.role: Settled safety supplies the inward capacity to receive abundance without fear.
Fullness that spills and becomes visible gives laughter the function of embodied overflow.
A good and favored condition supplies the encompassing state from which joy can overflow.
The face as the forward surface supplies the display site for inward condition.
Fresh radiance supplies a prior visible sign of bliss that laughter can intensify.
A pure selected drink supplies the material fullness surrounding the laughing subjects.
A precious object that draws competing selves turns plenitude into an actively desired culmination.

structural_cues: 83:22-28 accumulates condition, face, radiance, drink, scent, mixture, and spring immediately before the two laughter scenes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily radiance and consumable abundance; I infer an inward-fullness-to-visible-laughter arrow, while direct counter-mockery remains equally live because the focus retains its min-phrase.

changed_reading.before: The opponents alone cause the believers' laughter.
changed_reading.after: The opponents remain its object, but not its whole cause: security and plenitude overflow through the face as laughter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier clause makes believers the object of criminal laughter; the focus repeats its grammar with subject and object exchanged, while turning, facing, and equal counterpart branches extend that reversal into the visual field.

activation_trace.role: Object-directed mockery anchors the focus as the second half of a reciprocal social relation.
The same trusting group appears earlier as the target, fixing the participant whose grammatical role later changes.
Earlier object-directed laughter supplies the first orientation that the focus clause mirrors.
Turning a thing from its face supplies a local reversal operation between the two laughter clauses.
Mutual facing and seeing turn ridicule into a contested visual relation, not only a spoken judgment.
Matching counterpart with counterpart until equality supplies a striking image for proportionate reversal under the final gaze.

structural_cues: 83:29 and 83:34 repeat faith and laughter with subject and min-object exchanged; the branchless mutual-winking form in 83:30 carries ridicule between them; 83:23 and 83:35 repeat the couch-and-looking line.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact participant reversal, intervening gaze language, and a repeated viewing frame; I infer deliberate mirrored reciprocity, while generic joy at judgment remains possible without this social geometry.

changed_reading.before: The second laughter resembles the first only because both groups happen to laugh.
changed_reading.after: The second laughter is the formally mirrored return of the first: target becomes subject, watcher becomes watched, and the gaze is brought to proportion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate denial that the mockers were commissioned as guardians dismantles their inspecting authority. The focus laughter can therefore register release from an unauthorized gaze, not merely adoption of that gaze in reverse.

activation_trace.role: Settled security supplies the state restored when hostile inspection loses authority.
The opened face supplies a bodily release from the constriction of being watched.
Commissioning and dispatch supply the authority relation that the ayah explicitly negates.
Guarding observation supplies the surveillance role denied to the earlier mockers.

structural_cues: The negated commission in 83:33 stands immediately before the fa-marked present reversal in 83:34.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a negated guardian commission directly before laughter; I infer that deauthorization enables felt release, while the live alternative treats 83:33 only as a rebuke with no causal force on 83:34.

changed_reading.before: The believers answer hostile scrutiny with equivalent hostile scrutiny.
changed_reading.after: Their laughter can mark liberation from the mockers' false office: the gaze that classified them has lost jurisdiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The accusation of straying activates path semantics; the focus laughter's open-road branch then answers not merely with emotion but with manifest route-clarity, sharpened by a form-distant straight-road branch under the denied guardianship.

activation_trace.role: A clear open road lets laughter function as unmistakable direction rather than only sound or facial motion.
Deviation from intended guidance supplies the path accusation that the focus can overturn.
A preserving straight road supplies exploratory route imagery precisely where the accusers' right to guard is denied.

structural_cues: 83:32's declaration that the believers are astray is immediately followed by 83:33's denial that the speakers are their keepers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a straying accusation, denied guardianship, and an open-road branch in the focus verb; I infer route reclassification, while ordinary reciprocal laughter remains the materially closer reading.

changed_reading.before: Laughter merely humiliates those who misnamed the believers.
changed_reading.after: Laughter also makes the route visible: those pronounced astray now occupy the clear road, while their classifiers are exposed as unauthorized guides.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing question defines recompense as an action returning to its doer. That return converts focus laughter from autonomous revenge into one moment of consequence generated by the earlier agents' own deeds.

activation_trace.role: Being made the object of laughter supplies the visible reversed consequence that requires causal containment.
Recompense returning to the worker supplies the causal loop that sends prior conduct back to its source.
The production of an act supplies the originating input for the returned result.

structural_cues: 83:36 follows the focus and repeated couch-viewing line with a question that explicitly ties what happens to what the unbelievers had been doing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies returned recompense and authored action; I infer that the intervening laughter participates in that return, while an alternative reads 83:36 as an independent summary after a scene of joy.

changed_reading.before: The laughter is a fresh act of vengeance chosen by the newly advantaged group.
changed_reading.after: The laughter is folded into returned consequence: prior mockery and judgment come back to their makers rather than licensing unbounded vengeance.

changed_reading.after: Beneath that social reversal lies a material analogy: a covering reaches the moment when it splits, so the hidden order emerges into view.

surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Rare branches under the focus roots at words 5 and 6 converge on aroma, sweetness, whiteness, foam, and visible brightness.

White honey, foam, snow, or light supplies sweetness and visible brightness from the laughter root.
A pure selected drink activates the otherwise remote sweetness and liquid imagery.

changed_reading.before: The laughter scene is socially sharp but sensorially abstract.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, the scene acquires the preceding feast's white, sweet, foaming, aromatic brightness, so vindication is tasted and seen as well as socially enacted.

strongest_changes: The focus laughter became the exact grammatical return of the earlier laughter, not merely a second instance of amusement.
The measuring prologue and returned-recompense close constrained reversal as proportional settlement rather than unlimited revenge.
Records, barriers, witnesses, faces, and gaze turned laughter into public disclosure of what had been covered.
The bliss sequence preserved a coexisting affective reading in which security and abundance overflow through the face.
The denied guardian role opened a distinct reading of laughter as release from unauthorized classification.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots generated unusually coherent cover/open, inward/outward, and object/subject reversals. Context did not collapse them into one verdict: legal balancing, epistemic manifestation, bodily plenitude, social mirroring, and exploratory material opening remain simultaneously active.
remaining_uncertainties: The min-phrase strongly supports directed laughter but does not decide whether derision, wonder, relief, or visible proof dominates its affect.
The economic balancing model is structurally strong, though the arrow from commercial shortfall to social laughter is reader-supplied.
The clear-road model depends on form-distant branches and should remain exploratory.
The botanical and white-aromatic outliers are resonances only and must not be converted into lexical claims about the focus nouns.
